ar.title: السراب في 39 ثانية: لماذا يبدو الطريق مبلولًا؟
ar.description:
لماذا نرى ماءً على الطريق في الحر وهو غير موجود؟ إنه السراب: الأسفلت الحار يسخّن الهواء فوقه، والضوء تتغيّر سرعته بين الهواء الحار والبارد فينحني.
ينزل ضوء السماء ثم ينعطف للأعلى ويدخل عينك من الأسفل، فيظن دماغك أنه جاء مستقيمًا ويرى السماء على الأرض.

ولهذا كلما اقتربت منه ابتعد.

#علوم #سراب #shorts

en.title: That Puddle on the Road Is the Sky
en.description:
Why does a hot road look wet when it is bone dry? A road mirage: hot asphalt heats the air above it, light changes speed between hot and cool air and bends.
Sky light dips down, curves back up and enters your eye from below. Your brain assumes it came in a straight line, so you see the sky on the road.

That is also why it keeps moving away as you drive closer.

#science #physics #shorts
tags: why does the road look wet
en.first_comment: Have you ever chased a road mirage? 👇

hooks.ar: تشوف مويه في الطريق قدامك… بس عمرها ما تكون موجودة! ليش؟
hooks.en: You see water on the road ahead, but it is never there. Why?
Your eyes are not lying: the road mirage is real light. How?

facts: Hot asphalt heats the layer of air directly above it (heat transfer).
Light travels slightly faster in hotter, less dense air (lower refractive index), so a gradient bends it (refraction).
In an inferior mirage, sky light curves upward near a hot surface and reaches the eye from below; the brain projects it straight back, showing an image of the sky on the ground.
The mirage recedes as you approach because it only appears at shallow viewing angles.
